_about: Catalog of ready-made 3D models for the Lego look (built by tools/model_library.py index). Use one in a shot with <KitModel file="<file>" h={h} /> from the kit; h = real height in metres (a kit person is 1.75), l = length. clips = the model is rigged and moves: use <AnimatedModel file h clip="Walk" t={t} /> with one of these motion names. code: true = an object built for an earlier video, reused by copying library/props/<name>.tsx into the video as _prop_<name>.tsx.
